training.checkpoint_selection: Library best checkpoint using only the EPRI plus UK development split; acceptance is unavailable to training and selection.

evaluation.threshold_selection: All settings copied from the frozen v1 technique study before any v2 acceptance inference; no v2 threshold tuning or retry.

model_role: A single-class insulator proposal specialist. It does not replace the preserved pole/crossarm component detector and does not classify material.
claim_boundary: Small prospective UK technique check with analyst visible-object references, not expert inspection truth or UK population accuracy. Raw detector scores are uncalibrated and are not probabilities. Repeated UK crops are training views, not independent assets.
budget: One fixed 10-epoch Roihu gputest training run followed by one frozen baseline/adapted evaluation on the untouched v2 cohort. No acceptance-selected retry or hyperparameter extension.
